description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Web and domain checks] Follows the redirects of one public http(s) URL hop by hop and returns each hop's URL, status code, Location header and time in ms, with flags for loops, HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, more than 10 redirects and cross-domain hops. Input: url. Limits: up to 15 redirects, 8 s per hop, public hosts only; robots.txt is checked before every hop is requested (a disallowed hop is reported, not requested). Not cached.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: redirect_chain
title: Redirect chain: every hop with status, Location and time
